# Configuration

Routine package metadata is declared directly in the `[project]` table of
`pyproject.toml`. PDM resolves dependency declarations into `pdm.lock`;
`prek.toml` and workflows configure development tools and CI.

Start here:

- [Basic](basic.md) – common settings for most use cases
- [Advanced](advanced.md) – for adding tool groups or complex changes

> [!TIP]
> For deeper insight and easier adjustments,
> see the [Details documentation](../details/index.md).
